# HR Partner

HR Partner is a human resources platform for managing employee records, leave, recruitment, performance, timesheets, expenses, and related company data.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hr-partner/.

## Actions

- **Get Company** (read-only): Return the connected HR Partner company's identity, subscription status, workforce counts, timezone, and optionally its custom fields and…
- **Get Employee** (read-only): Return one employee's detailed HR profile, organization placement, manager, tags, contacts, addresses, and custom data by employee code.
- **Get Recruitment Record** (read-only): Return one detailed job, applicant, or application using an identifier from recruitment search results.
- **List Employee Records** (read-only): List employee contacts, addresses, goals, checklists, absences, assets, attachments, benefits, dependents, education, grievances,…
- **List Employees** (read-only): Find employee summaries using name, organization, status, tag, manager, and employment-date filters.
- **List Expenses** (read-only): Return expense claims as a detailed, summary, or transaction report with employee, organization, date, status, payment, category, and…
- **List Leave Data** (read-only): List either leave requests or employee leave balances using only filters supported by the selected data type.
- **List Performance Reviews** (read-only): List performance-management review cycles by employee, organization, status, and review dates, optionally including selected reviewer…
- **List Timesheets** (read-only): List timesheet sequences and entries by employee, organization, sequence dates, status, project, activity, and approval, export, or lock…
- **Search Recruitment** (read-only): List jobs, applicants, applications for one job, or application stage changes using resource-appropriate recruitment filters.
